setupDiagnostic.guidance.accurate: unverified: 'never retries' and 'report leaves out addresses and passwords' are backend behaviour
setupDiagnostic.guidance.proposed: Mailven tests that it can connect securely and sign in with these settings. It doesn't send any mail. A successful test doesn't prove you may send from this address or that mail arrives. It runs only when you start it. To sign in again, use the account's Sign in again option. The exported report leaves out email addresses and passwords.
setupDiagnostic.guidance.notes: COPY-1 (long, 4 ideas), COPY-6; consider split into two lines

setupDiagnostic.route.notes: Single option and disabled; hide or drop (P4)

setupDiagnostic.owned.proposed: Also check the domain records for a domain I own
setupDiagnostic.owned.notes: COPY-4 DNS; checkbox applies at Start

setupDiagnostic.selectors.accurate: unverified: 'maximum 10' not enforced in this component
setupDiagnostic.selectors.proposed: DKIM selectors from your provider (optional, separate with commas, up to 10)
setupDiagnostic.selectors.notes: CTRL-5: expert, move to Advanced; COPY-4

setupDiagnostic.failed.proposed: Mailven couldn't start the check. Make sure the account, From address and server names are saved, then try again.

setupDiagnostic.cancelFailed.proposed: Couldn't cancel the check. It will stop on its own when time runs out.

setupDiagnostic.exportFailed.proposed: Couldn't save the report. Run the check again, then retry.

setupDiagnostic.oauth.notes: COPY-4 OAuth; detail layer only already (inside Details)

setupDiagnostic.age.notes: Value is raw seconds like 12s (UX CTRL-9 units); SetupDiagnosticSection.svelte:80

setupDiagnostic.outcome.sending.problem.proposed: Something failed. Open Details to see which step.

setupDiagnostic.outcome.dns.problem.proposed: A record is missing or wrong. Open Details to see which.

setupDiagnostic.outcome.dns.unconfirmed.proposed: Mailven couldn't look up a record. Open Details to see which.

setupDiagnostic.outcome.dns.notChecked.proposed: Not checked. Select the domain option to check them.

setupDiagnostic.outcome.permissions.ok.proposed: Your saved sign-in includes the permissions Mailven needs.

setupDiagnostic.outcome.permissions.prob.proposed: Your saved sign-in is missing a permission. Sign in again to grant it.

setupDiagnostic.outcome.permissions.unco.proposed: Your provider decides whether you may send from this address, and Mailven couldn't confirm it.
